title: Oil Surges With No Hormuz Deal in Sight—Heard on the Street Monday Recap
title_zh: 霍尔木兹协议尚未达成，石油价格飙升——周一街头回顾
summary: Oil prices jumped yesterday after negotiations over the Strait of Hormuz turned south once again.
summary_zh: 霍尔木兹海峡谈判再次转向南面后，油价昨天上涨。

title: Intel Increases Size of Stock Offering to Raise $20 Billion
title_zh: 英特尔增加股票发行规模，筹集 200 亿美元
summary: Intel plans to raise $20 billion by way of an underwritten public offering of 210.5 million shares priced at $95 each.
summary_zh: 英特尔计划通过承销公开发行 2.105 亿股每股定价 95 美元的股票筹集 200 亿美元资金。

title: AI’s biggest buildout is here. These stocks offer a way to invest in the data center boom
title_zh: 人工智能最大的扩展就在这里。这些股票提供了一种投资数据中心繁荣的方式
summary: For those seeking a pick-and-shovel approach to the AI wave, here's a guide to utilities, grid hardware, cooling firms, and refinery stocks.
summary_zh: 对于那些寻求以铲铲方式应对人工智能浪潮的人来说，这里有一份有关公用事业、电网硬件、冷却公司和炼油厂股票的指南。

title: Jim Cramer Recommends Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley to Profit From Accelerating M&A Deals
title_zh: 吉姆克莱默建议高盛和摩根士丹利从加速并购交易中获利

summary_zh: 在《Mad Money》8 月 6 日的节目中，主持人吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 强调了为什么投资者应该瞄准精英咨询公司，而不是猜测收购目标，他说： 这是一个目前实际上只影响两家大公司的大主题：被压抑的合并需求和……

title: Making Sense of the Multibillion-Dollar Numbers of Nvidia Deal, Intel Share Sale
title_zh: 理解英伟达数十亿美元交易、英特尔股票出售的意义
summary: Nvidia is becoming the "banker of choice to the AI ecosystem" as it seals $500 billion commitments from Wall Street giants. Meanwhile, Intel is looking at its first share sale since the 1970s.
summary_zh: 随着华尔街巨头 5000 亿美元的承诺，Nvidia 正在成为“人工智能生态系统的首选银行家”。与此同时，英特尔正在考虑自 20 世纪 70 年代以来的首次股票发行。
